value.rationale: The seven-cycle is the first odd-cycle case beyond the five-cycle graph illustration in the initiating 2026 article. State complexity of its remanent oriented-walk language is a canonical and mathematically natural minimization invariant. The exact 102-class result is a nontrivial full finite classification of right quotients, quantifying the compression of the simultaneous 128-orientation recognition model from 230 reachable states. It supplies a reproducible benchmark for algorithms and future structural investigations of remanent languages, not just an arbitrary chosen substring statistic.
